payload.posture: Read 1 Corinthians 11:23–26 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states paul says he received and delivered the tradition: on the night betrayed Jesus took bread, gave thanks, named body and remembrance, then named the cup as new covenant and repeated remembrance until he comes. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Last Supper.
